description: Content ideas for a seed keyword, composed from three sources this codebase already fetches for other features: the SERP for the seed (titles of pages already ranking for it), PAA-style questions (real autocomplete completions reframed as questions), and autocomplete keyword suggestions. Grouped into topic clusters by shared phrasing, using the same phrase-clustering engine the saved-keyword Topic Clusters feature uses. FREE — none of the three sources is billable in this codebase today. Three real upstream calls per request, so it is rate limited. NOT a Keywords-Explorer-style overlap report: this codebase has no keyword-to-URL index, so `clusters` group the REAL text of three OBSERVED sources rather than a fabricated 'what else these pages rank for'. `coverage.serpUnavailable`/`suggestionsUnavailable` mean that source could not be asked at all — distinct from that source genuinely returning nothing — and one source being unavailable never sinks the other two. Every idea not assigned to a cluster is still returned in `ungrouped`, never discarded.

languageCode.description: Language code. Defaults to the project's stored market, else 'en'.

locationCode.description: Numeric location code. Defaults to the project's stored market, else 2840 (United States).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_topic_research
